standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of profinite spaces as Hausdorff quasi-compact totally disconnected
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source line 4457)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the three properties.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the image of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact, and that the space of components is totally disconnected by construction
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4458-4461)

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a component is the intersection of the clopens containing it, together with the finite intersection criterion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4463-4468)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a clopen separating two components.

core_obligations: Quasi-compactness: the space of components is the image of a quasi-compact space (proof lines 4458-4459)
Total disconnectedness: this holds by construction for the space of components (proof lines 4460-4461)

Hausdorffness: for two distinct components the hypothesis writes one of them as an intersection of clopens, the finite intersection criterion produces a single clopen missing the other component, and that clopen is the preimage of a clopen of the component space, separating the two points (proof lines 4462-4475)
proof_roadmap: 由 profinite ⟺ Hausdorff + 准紧 + 完全不连通，只需证三条。
π_0(X) 是准紧空间的像 ⇒ 准紧；按构造完全不连通。
取两个不同分支 C, D：由假设 C = ∩U_α，且 ∩U_α ∩ D = ∅ ⇒ 某 U_α ∩ D = ∅（有限交判据）；U_α 既开又闭 ⇒ 是若干分支之并 ⇒ 是某个 V_α ⊂ π_0(X) 的原像 ⇒ 分离两点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the space of connected components of a quasi-compact space, each component being the intersection of the clopens containing it, is profinite (author lemma at source lines 4448-4454, label lemma-pi0-profinite). The proof (source lines 4456-4476) checks quasi-compactness and total disconnectedness and obtains Hausdorffness by separating two components with a single clopen produced from the finite intersection criterion (proof lines 4456-4475). The separation by a clopen is the substance. H3.
